name: idyll
description: Language support for Idyll: syntax highlighting, and, from front/'s language server (`Idyll lsp`), semantic highlighting, diagnostics, hover with doc comments, go-to-definition, references, rename, inlay hints, completion, an outline, formatting on save, a test runner and an IR view.

idyll.server.path.description: Path to front/'s executable, `Idyll` (built by `meadow build --release` in front/, at front/target/release/native/silo/Idyll); the extension runs `Idyll lsp`. Left at `Idyll`, it is looked for, as `idyll-front` (the name scripts/install.sh installs it under) or `Idyll`, on your PATH, in $IDYLL_HOME/bin and ~/.idyll/bin, and, in a trusted workspace, at front/target/release/native/silo/Idyll in an open folder.

idyll.driver.path.description: Path to the Rust driver, `idyll`, which runs a test from the "Test" lens (`idyll test --exact`). Left at `idyll`, it is looked for on your PATH, in $IDYLL_HOME/bin and ~/.idyll/bin, where scripts/install.sh puts it.

idyll.test.codeLens.description: Show a "Test" link above each `@test`, which runs that one test with `idyll test --exact`.

idyll.inlayHints.enabled.description: Show the types the checker gave parameters and `let` bindings that have none written.

idyll.trace.server.description: Log the traffic between VS Code and the language server.

test.description: The whole name of the test to run: `Module.test`, or the bare name in the package's root module.
